SessionStart.command: bash -c 'echo "[SCALE] 认知工作流提醒: 1.扫描技能 2.确认任务级别(S/M/L/CRITICAL) 3.执行阶段流程"; echo "输出格式: [SKILL SCAN] ✓ | [EXPLORE] ✓ | [PLAN] ✓ | ..."'

PreToolUse.command: bash -c 'FILEPATH="${CLAUDE_FILE_PATH:-$FILEPATH}"; if [ -z "$FILEPATH" ]; then exit 0; fi; if echo "$FILEPATH" | grep -qE "(migration|\.db|\.env|schema)"; then echo "[SCALE 🛡️] BLOCKED: 危险文件修改 $FILEPATH — 需要人工确认"; exit 2; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'FILEPATH="${CLAUDE_FILE_PATH:-$FILEPATH}"; if [ -z "$FILEPATH" ]; then exit 0; fi; if echo "$FILEPATH" | grep -qE "(core/|server/|apps/|packages/)" && ! echo "$FILEPATH" | grep -qE "(test|spec|__tests__)"; then echo "[SCALE TDD] ⚠️ 实现文件 $FILEPATH — 请确保有对应测试"; fi; exit 0'

Stop.command: bash -c 'cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null; if [ -f .claude/scripts/gates/all.sh ]; then bash .claude/scripts/gates/all.sh || { echo "[SCALE ✅] 门控未通过，不可声称完成"; exit 1; }; else echo "[SCALE ✅] 缺少 .claude/scripts/gates/all.sh，不可声称完成"; exit 1; fi'
